safety: aggregates only; no payload text, URLs, credentials or names; template ids are sha256 prefixes of normalized text

tags.note: tags mark article-evidence rows only; they are not a technique taxonomy

1_schema.cite_format: '<id>:<8 hex>' where the hex is sha256(text)[:8] (verified on all rows)

2_forest.interpretation: parent_id links a reassembled payload to (a) recovered_text rows = decoded layers / extracted fragments of that payload and (b) response rows = content returned when the payload's link chain was followed. Links never connect one payload to another payload, so trees are intra-payload decompositions, not agent-to-agent cascades.

3_actor_proxies.agent_id_values: every agent_id value is the unnumbered [REDACTED:runtime_identifier]

technique_definitions.js_dom_or_image_beacon: JavaScript DOM access or image-src beacon
technique_definitions.hf_hub_access: reference to the Hugging Face Hub or its API / redacted HF repo
technique_definitions.cloud_metadata_or_signing: cloud instance-metadata endpoint or AWS request signing
technique_definitions.template_injection: server-side template expression reaching Python dunder attributes
technique_definitions.env_or_secret_read: reading environment variables or credential files
technique_definitions.identity_recon: identity / host reconnaissance (whoami, uname, hostname, passwd)
technique_definitions.path_traversal_or_file_url: dot-dot path traversal or file:// URL

3_actor_proxies.technique_definition_method: case-insensitive regex per category over row text (see TECHNIQUES in realdata/swarmtraces.py); a tree uses a category if any of its rows matches
